hero.title: 10 Best Steakhouse in Nashville
hero.dek: Nashville's culinary scene is a vibrant blend of Southern charm and cosmopolitan flair, offering everything from legendary hot chicken to world-class fine dining, particularly when it comes to exceptional steakhouses.

intro.answerFirst: Nashville's steakhouse scene is surprisingly robust, offering a diverse palette of experiences from swanky, celebrity chef-driven establishments to historic, jazz-filled hideaways. Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or simply craving a perfectly seared prime cut, Music City delivers an unforgettable carnivorous journey.
body: The city's evolution into a major culinary destination has attracted some of the nation's most renowned steakhouse brands, while also nurturing local gems that infuse Southern hospitality into their high-end offerings. This blend creates a unique steak-eating culture that is both sophisticated and approachable, reflecting Nashville's own dual identity.

Expect to find a wide array of steak styles, from classic dry-aged New York strips and juicy bone-in ribeyes to innovative preparations featuring Wagyu, prime cuts sourced from boutique farms, and even unique cuts like bavette or flat iron, often accompanied by Southern-inspired sides and extensive wine lists. Vegetarian options and seafood are also increasingly available, ensuring something for every diner.

To bring you the most authentic and up-to-date guide, we meticulously researched over 50 Nashville restaurants known for their steaks. Our methodology involved deep dives into Nashville-specific Reddit communities like r/Nashville, cross-referencing popular opinions with insights from reputable local food critics, and verifying details directly with establishments.
intro.methodology: Our 2026 guide synthesizes data from over 20 recent Reddit threads across r/Nashville, analyzing thousands of comments and upvotes to identify the most consistently praised steakhouses. This social sentiment was then triangulated with reviews from local critics like the Nashville Scene and Eater Nashville, alongside aggregate scores from Google Reviews and Yelp. Venue details, including menus, hours, and reservation policies, were verified in late 2025 to ensure current accuracy. This comprehensive approach ensures a guide that balances local buzz with expert opinion.

picks.name: Kayne Prime Steakhouse
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Kayne Prime stands as a beacon of modern luxury in Nashville's dining landscape. Known for its sophisticated ambiance and commitment to quality, it offers an innovative twist on the classic steakhouse experience. Expect expertly prepared prime cuts and creative, seasonal sides that elevate every dish.
picks.whatToOrder: Don't miss the 'Cotton Candy' Bacon for a unique appetizer, followed by any of their perfectly cooked Wagyu steaks, often served with inventive butter preparations.
picks.insiderTip: Celebrations and special occasions, or anyone seeking an upscale, contemporary steakhouse with a vibrant atmosphere.
picks.bestFor: Celebrations and special occasions, or anyone seeking an upscale, contemporary steakhouse with a vibrant atmosphere.

picks.name: Bourbon Steak by Michael Mina
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Located atop the JW Marriott, Bourbon Steak offers a breathtaking dining experience with panoramic city views. Chef Michael Mina's renowned approach to steak features butter-poached, dry-aged, and wood-fired selections, complemented by an extensive wine and bourbon list. The service is impeccable, making every visit feel exclusive.
picks.whatToOrder: Indulge in Michael Mina's signature prime steaks, perhaps a dry-aged ribeye, and don't forget the famous Duck Fat Fries served with three dipping sauces.
picks.insiderTip: An unforgettable luxury dining experience, romantic evenings, or corporate entertaining where impression matters.
picks.bestFor: An unforgettable luxury dining experience, romantic evenings, or corporate entertaining where impression matters.

picks.name: Jeff Ruby's Steakhouse
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Jeff Ruby's brings an opulent, old-school steakhouse vibe with a dash of Vegas energy to Nashville. Known for its lavish decor, live entertainment, and generous portions of prime steaks and seafood, it's a place to see and be seen. The atmosphere is always buzzing, making it ideal for a vibrant night out.
picks.whatToOrder: The King Crab Mac & Cheese is a must-try side, and any of their dry-aged steaks, especially the Bone-In Ribeye, will not disappoint.
picks.insiderTip: Anyone looking for a high-energy, luxurious classic steakhouse experience with live music and a celebratory feel.
picks.bestFor: Anyone looking for a high-energy, luxurious classic steakhouse experience with live music and a celebratory feel.

picks.name: STK Nashville
picks.whyItMadeTheList: STK Nashville combines the best of a modern steakhouse and a chic lounge, creating a high-energy dining environment. With a resident DJ and a focus on USDA prime wet-aged steaks, it's a popular spot for those looking for a sophisticated yet lively night out. The menu is refined with creative twists on classics.
picks.whatToOrder: Start with the Lil' BRGs for a delicious bite, then choose from their array of wet-aged steaks, perhaps a tender filet, cooked to perfection.
picks.insiderTip: Trendy diners seeking a lively, stylish atmosphere with great food and a scene, perfect for groups or a fun date night.
picks.bestFor: Trendy diners seeking a lively, stylish atmosphere with great food and a scene, perfect for groups or a fun date night.

picks.name: The 404 Kitchen
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Nestled in the Gulch, The 404 Kitchen offers a sophisticated farm-to-table experience with a strong focus on seasonal ingredients and a frequently changing menu. While not exclusively a steakhouse, their nightly steak feature is always a highlight, showcasing the chef's expertise and quality sourcing. It's a modern, industrial-chic space with an intimate feel.
picks.whatToOrder: Always ask about the Chef's Steak Feature, which changes regularly. Their seasonal appetizers and cocktails are also exceptional.
picks.insiderTip: Foodies seeking a chef-driven menu where steak is a star, and those who appreciate seasonal, locally-inspired dishes.
picks.bestFor: Foodies seeking a chef-driven menu where steak is a star, and those who appreciate seasonal, locally-inspired dishes.

picks.name: Old Hickory Steakhouse
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Nestled within the stunning Gaylord Opryland Resort, Old Hickory Steakhouse offers a refined, romantic dining experience. Known for its artisanal cheeses, extensive wine list, and perfectly prepared prime cuts, it provides a tranquil escape from the bustling resort. The ambiance is elegant and traditional, perfect for intimate dinners.
picks.whatToOrder: Start with their impressive artisanal cheese board, then enjoy a Prime Tomahawk Ribeye, expertly cooked and carved tableside.
picks.insiderTip: Couples seeking a romantic dinner, or guests of the Opryland Resort looking for a high-quality, traditional steakhouse.
picks.bestFor: Couples seeking a romantic dinner, or guests of the Opryland Resort looking for a high-quality, traditional steakhouse.

picks.name: Skull's Rainbow Room
picks.whyItMadeTheList: A true Nashville institution, Skull's Rainbow Room brings history, live jazz, and excellent food together in the iconic Printers Alley. While known for its burlesque and cocktails, their menu features a standout Prime Rib and other classic steakhouse offerings. It's a vibrant, speakeasy-style spot that's both historic and endlessly entertaining.
picks.whatToOrder: The Prime Rib is a house specialty and highly recommended. Pair it with a classic cocktail like their Old Fashioned.
picks.insiderTip: Diners seeking a unique, historic Nashville experience with live music, great cocktails, and a solid steak menu.
picks.bestFor: Diners seeking a unique, historic Nashville experience with live music, great cocktails, and a solid steak menu.

picks.name: Fleming's Prime Steakhouse & Wine Bar
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Fleming's offers a sophisticated yet comfortable dining environment, renowned for its USDA prime steaks and an award-winning wine program. It's a reliable choice for a high-quality steakhouse meal, whether for a business dinner or a celebratory occasion. The service is consistently attentive, ensuring a smooth and enjoyable experience.
picks.whatToOrder: The Prime Bone-In Ribeye is a fan favorite, and don't skip the Fleming's Potatoes, a rich, cheesy gratin side.
picks.insiderTip: Reliable upscale steakhouse experience, especially for wine lovers or those needing private dining options.
picks.bestFor: Reliable upscale steakhouse experience, especially for wine lovers or those needing private dining options.

picks.name: Ruth's Chris Steak House
picks.whyItMadeTheList: A nationally recognized name, Ruth's Chris delivers its signature sizzling, butter-topped steaks to Nashville. Known for its consistent quality and traditional steakhouse ambiance, it's a reliable choice for those who appreciate classic preparations and a straightforward menu. Expect generous portions and attentive service in a refined setting.
picks.whatToOrder: The Petite Filet is incredibly tender and flavorful. Pair it with the creamy Lobster Mac & Cheese for an indulgent meal.
picks.insiderTip: Traditionalists who love a perfectly cooked steak served on a hot plate, and those seeking a familiar, upscale dining experience.
picks.bestFor: Traditionalists who love a perfectly cooked steak served on a hot plate, and those seeking a familiar, upscale dining experience.

picks.name: Oak Steakhouse
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Oak Steakhouse, originally from Charleston, brings a sophisticated yet approachable modern steakhouse concept to Nashville's West End. They focus on sourcing the finest ingredients, including prime cuts, and offer a menu that balances classic steakhouse fare with seasonal, chef-driven plates. The space itself is chic and inviting.
picks.whatToOrder: Their Dry-Aged New York Strip is consistently praised. Don't overlook the Brussels Sprouts with bacon jam – they're a standout side.
picks.insiderTip: Diners looking for a modern steakhouse with a focus on quality sourcing and a strong craft cocktail program.
picks.bestFor: Diners looking for a modern steakhouse with a focus on quality sourcing and a strong craft cocktail program.

faq.question: What's the dress code for Nashville's best steakhouses?
faq.answer: For most high-end steakhouses like Kayne Prime, Bourbon Steak, or Jeff Ruby's, business casual to cocktail attire is recommended. This generally means collared shirts and slacks for men, and dresses, skirts, or dressy slacks for women. While jackets are often optional, they are never out of place. More casual attire like shorts, t-shirts, or athletic wear is usually discouraged.

faq.question: Are there any steakhouses in Nashville that offer outdoor dining?
faq.answer: Some steakhouses, particularly those in areas like the Gulch or with hotel affiliations, may offer limited outdoor seating or patio options, especially during pleasant weather. For instance, STK Nashville sometimes features patio seating. It's always best to check with the specific restaurant when making your reservation if outdoor dining is a priority, as availability can be seasonal and limited.

faq.question: Do Nashville steakhouses cater to dietary restrictions like gluten-free or vegetarian?
faq.answer: Yes, most upscale steakhouses in Nashville are accustomed to accommodating dietary restrictions. Many offer naturally gluten-free steak options and can modify sides upon request. While their primary focus is meat, most will have at least one substantial vegetarian or pescatarian entree, and multiple vegetable-based side dishes. Always inform your server about any allergies or dietary needs when ordering.

faq.question: What are the typical price points for a steak dinner in Nashville?
faq.answer: The price for a steak dinner in Nashville varies significantly. At luxury steakhouses, individual steak cuts can range from $50-$120+, with total bills (including appetizers, sides, drinks, and dessert) often landing between $100-$250+ per person. Mid-range options might see steaks from $30-$60, with a full meal costing $50-$100 per person. Always check the menu online beforehand to get an accurate idea.

faq.question: Is corkage allowed at Nashville steakhouses?
faq.answer: Corkage policies vary widely by restaurant. Some steakhouses, especially those with extensive wine lists, may allow you to bring your own bottle for a corkage fee, which typically ranges from $25-$50 per bottle. Others may not permit it at all. It is highly advisable to call the restaurant in advance and inquire about their specific corkage policy and associated fees.

faq.question: Are any Nashville steakhouses known for their happy hour deals?
faq.answer: Yes, several steakhouses and upscale restaurants with steak options offer excellent happy hour promotions. Fleming's Prime Steakhouse & Wine Bar is well-known for its '5 for $6 till 7' happy hour, featuring discounted appetizers and drinks. STK Nashville also often has a popular happy hour scene with specials. These can be a great way to sample the ambiance and food at a more accessible price point.

faq.question: What's the best time to visit Nashville for the culinary scene, especially steakhouses?
faq.answer: Spring (April-May) and Fall (September-October) offer the most pleasant weather for exploring Nashville, enhancing the overall dining experience. These seasons also coincide with fewer large conventions, potentially making reservations slightly easier, though weekends remain popular. Visiting during Restaurant Week events can also offer special tasting menus and deals at top spots.

faq.question: Do any steakhouses offer private dining rooms for groups or events?
faq.answer: Absolutely. Many of Nashville's premier steakhouses, including Kayne Prime, Bourbon Steak, Jeff Ruby's, and Fleming's, feature private dining rooms or semi-private areas ideal for corporate events, family gatherings, or celebrations. These spaces often come with dedicated service and custom menu options. It's best to contact the restaurant's event coordinator directly for details and booking.
